business_summary: A DTC apparel brand selling comfort socks and tees with a 1-for-1 donation model supporting individuals experiencing homelessness. The brand has an average order value of $65 and targets families and gift-buyers.
stated_claims: Every purchase donates an item to someone experiencing homelessness

relevant_tags.why: Core product offered by the advertiser.
Socks and tees are core everyday basics.
Broad category for socks and tees.
Explicitly stated as great for gifting.
Socks and tees are casual everyday wear.

note_signals.why: Perfect match: sells socks/basics, has strong gifting season uplift, and audience responds to social-good messaging.
Values-driven shoppers will align well with the 1-for-1 donation model.
Family-oriented audience aligns with the advertiser's focus on families buying multi-packs.

gate_reason: The product, pricing, target audience, and social-good mission are clearly defined and ready for matching.
